page_title: TOT 4-1 NEW | Tottenham Hotspur v Newcastle 10/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

raw: van de Ven M. Thigh Injury

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+6' Callum Wilson (Newcastle Utd) meets an accurate cross in the box and steers a fine header towards the net. The goalkeeper has to react quickly to keep the ball out.
90+5' Callum Wilson (Newcastle Utd) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
90+4' Bryan Gil (Tottenham) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears.
90+4' Flag goes up against Callum Wilson (Newcastle Utd) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
90+1' 4 - 1 Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) breaks through before collecting a brilliant pass and producing a precise strike to beat the goalkeeper. The ball went into the bottom left corner.
90+1' Here is a change. Heung-Min Son is going off and Ange Postecoglou gives the last tactical orders to Jamie Donley (Tottenham).
90+1' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
89' The opposition can't get near Heung-Min Son (Tottenham), who finally takes a shot inside the box. The effort looks goalbound but veers just wide of the left post at the last second.

89' Oliver Skipp (Tottenham) gets on the end of a cross inside the box and sweeps the ball goalwards towards the right side of the goal, but Martin Dubravka is well positioned and easily deals with the effort.
86' That's the end of the game for Yves Bissouma, who is replaced by Bryan Gil (Tottenham).
86' Eddie Howe has decided to make a change. Emil Krafth (Newcastle Utd) replaces Kieran Trippier.
86' Substitution. Oliver Skipp (Tottenham) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Brennan Johnson walks off.
85' 4 - 0 Goal! Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) puts the ball into the bottom left corner past the outstretched arm of Martin Dubravka.
85' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
83' Martin Dubravka (Newcastle Utd) is penalised after knocking an opponent down. The referee points to the penalty spot. Tottenham are awarded a penalty kick!
83' Chris Kavanagh shows a yellow card to Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) for a tough tackle.
82' A cross into the box from Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) is cleared.
80' Chris Kavanagh shows a yellow card to Cristian Gabriel Romero (Tottenham) for his blatant foul.

80' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) takes the resulting free kick from outside the box. He sends a nice cross into the box, but his intention is well anticipated by the goalkeeper who comes out to collect the ball.
79' Newcastle have an opportunity from a mid-range free kick.
78' Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) jumps for a header from the resulting set piece, but it goes way wide of the right post.
77' Now Newcastle have a corner.
77' Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders. Newcastle win a corner.
76' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) unleashed a rocket of a shot aiming towards the left side of the goal, but the goalkeeper denies his attempt with a stunning save.
74' Substitution. Anthony Gordon will be replaced by Matt Ritchie (Newcastle Utd).
74' Today's match ends for Valentino Livramento who will be replaced by Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd).
73' Ange Postecoglou has decided to substitute Richarlison and he is replaced by Giovani Lo Celso (Tottenham).
73' Pape Matar Sarr will be replaced by Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Tottenham).
69' Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) takes out his opponent with a horrible challenge and is relieved when the referee only shows him a yellow card.
68' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) hits a shot towards the bottom left corner from the edge of the box, but it's a weak attempt and is easily saved by Martin Dubravka.
67' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the left side of the goal, but Martin Dubravka has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
67' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) looks up on the edge of the box and rifles in a screamer of a shot that flies just over the bar.
66' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 16:5.
66' 7:1 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
64' Eddie Howe decides to make a substitution. Alexander Isak will be replaced by Callum Wilson (Newcastle Utd).
64' Miguel Almiron goes off the pitch and Sean Longstaff (Newcastle Utd) comes on.
64' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) latches on to a lofted pass and strikes the ball! His attempt flies narrowly wide of the right post.
63' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) picks up an accurate pass inside the box and unleashes a shot goalwards that smashes against the left post. It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky.
60' 3 - 0 Goal! Pedro Porro puts a cross into the box and finds Richarlison (Tottenham), who latches on to it and strikes the ball into the bottom right corner. He makes it 3:0.
59' A yellow card for a tackle by Jamaal Lascelles (Newcastle Utd). Chris Kavanagh doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
59' A corner kick by Newcastle is thwarted by the well prepared Guglielmo Vicario (Tottenham).
56' Yves Bissouma (Tottenham) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Martin Dubravka.
54' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.

54' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety. Newcastle get a corner.
53' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) finds some space inside the box and latches on to a brilliant cross, but he wastes his chance as his shot goes way wide of the left post.
52' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.

51' The game is interrupted. Cristian Gabriel Romero (Tottenham) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did. Newcastle are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
49' Newcastle have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
47' Fabian Schar (Newcastle Utd) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Chris Kavanagh has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+4' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
45+1' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
45' Chris Kavanagh interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd).
45' Richarlison (Tottenham) jumps inside the box to meet the resulting set piece and aims a header towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper shows his reflexes and makes a superb save.
44' The referee awards a corner and Pedro Porro (Tottenham) goes over to take it.

44' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety.
43' One of the players from Tottenham times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
42' That was a wasted opportunity to score by Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham). He picks up the rebound and produces a poor effort which is easily saved by the goalkeeper.
41' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) misses the left post by a whisker with a mid-range rebound. What a chance that was!
38' 2 - 0 Goal! Heung-Min Son passes the ball to the feet of Richarlison (Tottenham), who has an empty net in front of him and has no problems in tapping the ball in. 2:0.
36' A long ball forward to Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) is intercepted.
34' The linesman signals that Richarlison (Tottenham) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
34' A pass into the box finds Miguel Almiron (Newcastle Utd) unmarked. He carefully places a shot low towards the middle of the goal, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Guglielmo Vicario denies him.
33' Newcastle are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
30' Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. His effort sails well wide of the left post.
29' A player from Newcastle commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
29' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.

29' Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. The linesman points to the corner flag, Newcastle are going to take it.
26' 1 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Heung-Min Son sprays a pass out to Destiny Udogie (Tottenham), and he has an easy job to slot the ball into an empty net. The score is 1:0.
25' Jamaal Lascelles (Newcastle Utd) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
25' Chris Kavanagh blows for a foul after Cristian Gabriel Romero (Tottenham) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
21' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) is penalised for a foul. Chris Kavanagh had a clear view and blows his whistle.
20' Richarlison (Tottenham) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Martin Dubravka, who smothers the ball.
18' Cristian Gabriel Romero (Tottenham) jumps inside the box to meet the corner and aims a header towards the right post, but the goalkeeper pulls off an astonishing save to deny him.
18' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
15' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
14' The game is interrupted. One of the players from Newcastle is cautioned for aggressive play.
12' Destiny Udogie (Tottenham) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
9' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) finds himself in a promising position after receiving an excellent pass into the box, but one of the defenders produces a timely intervention to avert the threat.
7' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) takes a shot after receiving a good pass, but his effort from the edge of the box goes just over the crossbar.
7' CHANCE! Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) receives a brilliant pass and finds himself one-on-one with Martin Dubravka, who reacts superbly to stop him.
6' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
6' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Richarlison (Tottenham) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
4' Richarlison (Tottenham) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
3' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! Newcastle will take the kick-off.
Chris Kavanagh is the one to supervise the game today.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
Show lineups
